Public domain: every person whose words are in this text died in 1925 or earlier, so the term has ended under the law of every country, whichever one first published it.

People: Joseph Barber Lightfoot (author, Wikidata Q1706574), died 1889. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Lightfoot, J. B. (Joseph Barber), 1828-1889") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: ST PAUL'S EPISTLES TO THE COLOSSIANS AND TO PHILEMON, 1875, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/stpaulsepistlest0000jbli_p0m2. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 69%, 58%, 83% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of Joseph Barber Lightfoot, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
